title: Unusable space.
officialText: In 1-hour fire-resistance-rated floor assemblies, the ceiling membrane is not required to be installed over unusable crawl spaces not intended for occupancy or storage, less than 24 inches (610 mm) in height. In 1-hour fire-resistance-rated roof assemblies, the floor membrane is not required to be installed where the unusable attic space above is not intended for occupancy or storage.
